label: D2 arrival at S1 after an unrewarded trial, early in the episode
explanation: Fires only at D2 (100% of mass) and only when the reached state is S1 (state input S1; 9 of 10982 activations on S2). Never fires at D1/GO or when the reward input is 1. Within S1 arrivals it favours trials whose previous outcome was unrewarded (90% of mass) and is strongly confined to early episode trials (rate 7x in trials 0-9, decays to zero by trial ~60), plus switch trials (stay==0, 3.7x lift). Predicate (D2, S1, prev unrewarded, ep_trial<30) gets dev P 0.40 / R 0.63 / mass recall 0.80, covering 90% of the top-quartile activations; the remaining false positives are similar-looking S1 arrivals where it stays silent, likely reflecting slow hidden-state drift over the episode that no simple observed variable captures. Only observed variables are used. Magnitude is largest early in the episode on S1 arrivals following a switch to a1 after no reward.
